verdict.rationale: Mailgun itself offers dedicated IP pools and IP pool management. A community user also reports running high volume on dedicated IPs. However, nothing in the evidence documents warmup, whether automated ramp-up or a published schedule, so only the dedicated-IP half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented automated IP warmup or a published warmup schedule, guidance on when to move from shared pools to dedicated IPs, and independent corroboration of the warmup process.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can get dedicated IPs with documented warmup — automated ramp-up or a published warmup schedule — when my volume outgrows shared pools

citations.quote: Manage IP pools to optimize email delivery and maintain sender reputation.
Working flawlessly, given that you setup everything correctly (separate domains, dedicated IPs...).
